name: ring mark forms from radiating strokes as captions explain the idea
looks: In total darkness, eight short curved strokes hang scattered in a loose circle, then snap inward until they close into a neat ring of pebble shapes, the brand's mark. Underneath, a line of mono caption text types on and gets hard-replaced by the next line every beat or two, laying out the premise before the mark has even finished forming.
build: A handful of seeded SVG stroke fragments tween from scattered start points and rotations to even positions on a circle on power3.out (about 0.4-0.6s each), snapping into their final pebble shape as they land. Captions are a single DOM text block whose string hard-swaps on the clock, with a blinking cursor square at the line's end.
sound: A soft rising tone as the fragments gather, a low click as the ring locks, and a quiet key-tick under each caption line.
prompt: Open on a handful of loose, scattered line fragments in the dark that snap together into the brand's own simple mark, while a short caption underneath hard-cuts through a few lines explaining the one idea the whole film is about, finishing just as the mark locks into place.
